parent_meaning_ref: JOYFLOW_v4_3_5 semantic-fidelity baseline as summarized in the v4.3.5 protocol repair report

added.product_meaning_closure: A confirmed product walkthrough and material ambiguity gate become an explicit lifecycle authority.
added.dual_layer_contract: Human semantic meaning and mechanical execution boundaries are represented together.
added.codex_interpretation_handshake: Non-LEAN work uses a short read-only interpretation artifact before mutation.
added.deviation_routing: Differences are classified as technical variation, Brain review, or user decision.
added.contract_time_user_acceptance: The same acceptance steps are fixed before implementation and reused downstream.
added.brain_original_problem_review: PR review must re-check the original problem and practically-wrong risk.
added.durable_product_fact_policy: Only stable reusable product facts are retained in the repository.

semantic_fidelity_model.from: Separate original-problem, semantic-delta, Golden Case, counterexample, and conditional-handshake fields.
semantic_fidelity_model.to: One explicit three-layer lifecycle connecting confirmed meaning, contract, interpretation, implementation evidence, Brain review, and user acceptance.

execution_release_gate.from: Execution may rely on conditional interpretation evidence without a first-class lifecycle step.
execution_release_gate.to: Non-LEAN execution is released only after an aligned interpretation; LEAN embeds the same fields without an extra transfer.

review_scope.from: Review includes original problem and semantic drift fields.
review_scope.to: Review compares original problem, confirmed meaning, contract, interpretation, diff, tests, Golden Cases, overdesign, scope drift, and practically-wrong risk.

unchanged: Web Brain remains the semantic decision layer.
Local Codex remains the bounded technical executor.
Human copy transfer and final acceptance remain part of the workflow.
GitHub remains the durable baseline and PR review surface.
Validator remains mechanical and cannot decide product meaning or subjective quality.
One complete execution Prompt is preferred.
LEAN tasks remain proportionate and avoid routine extra ceremony.
No autonomous background agent or dispatcher is introduced.
The frozen v4.3.5 package identity is not reused for modified content.
user_confirmation_reference: Project conversation on 2026-07-21 confirming all listed requirements for implementation.
